description: Build an IETF COSE Merkle inclusion proof (draft-ietf-cose-merkle-tree-proofs-18) over an ordered sequence of spatial stamps. Each stamp's leaf hash is combined into a tree head (tree_size + root_hash + timestamp); the returned chain carries the audit path segments needed to re-derive the root. Use for delivery audit trails and regulator-facing evidence.

stampIds.description: Ordered list of stamp IDs whose leaf hashes form the tree leaves.

name: proof_chain
